name: Villager
shortText: No special power. Watch, listen, and vote wisely.
powerText: You're an ordinary villager. You have no night action — your job is to pay attention by day and help vote out the wolves before they pick everyone off.

name: Werewolf
shortText: Each night, hunt with the pack and choose someone to eliminate.
powerText: Each night, you and the other werewolves silently agree on one player to eliminate. Your pack wins when wolves equal or outnumber the villagers.

name: Seer
shortText: Each night, secretly inspect one player's true allegiance.
powerText: Each night, choose one player. You'll privately learn whether they're a Werewolf or not. Keep it to yourself, or use it to guide the village — carefully.

name: Doctor
shortText: Each night, choose one player to protect from the wolves.
powerText: Each night, choose one player (yourself included) to protect. If the werewolves target that player tonight, they survive.
